answer_2.quote: we evaluate attack methods using the following metrics: 1) EM, the exact match ratio of predicted answers; 2) F1, the F1 score between the predicted answers and the gold answers; 3) Grammar error (GErr), the context grammatical error numbers...; 4) PPL, the average perplexity of all adversarial contexts...

answer_3.quote: we use a model to justify whether the question q is still answerable given the perturbed context... Such a model can be a large-scale pretrain model fine-tuned... PPL denotes the perplexity computed by a GPT2 model...

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation. We randomly sample 150 sets of adversarial samples... evaluated in two aspects: (1) Answer preservation, whether the gold answer of a sample remains unchanged; (2) Textual quality, ranking the quality (1 ∼ 3) of the context based on the fluency and grammaticality.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluate on answer preservation and textual quality based on fluency and grammaticality
